description: Use when you need what is said in a YouTube video: full transcript text plus timestamped segments, in the requested language (manual captions preferred, auto-generated as fallback, optional translation). Videos without captions and errors are not charged. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.002 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.

lang.description: Preferred language code(s), comma-separated, in order of preference.

translate.description: Translate the transcript into this language code if the video lacks it.

video.description: YouTube video URL or 11-character video ID.
